cases.situation: I work at a small camera shop. A customer wants the $1,200 telephoto lens to shoot his kid's school soccer games from the sideline. The $450 70 to 300 is light and would do fine outdoors; the $1,200 one is mainly better in low light.
cases.reply: For school soccer from the sideline, the 70 to 300 at $450 will honestly do the job, and it's light enough to carry all game. The $1,200 one earns its price in low light, so if you'll be shooting a lot of indoor or evening games, that's when it's worth it. Either one will get you great shots.
cases.note: The honest downsell is what makes your next recommendation believable.

cases.situation: I'm the receptionist at a hair salon. A client booked a cut with Ines on Saturday at 11 and mentioned she wants to go lighter for her sister's wedding next month. Face-framing highlights in the same visit would be $95 more and take about an hour longer.
cases.reply: You're booked with Ines for a cut on Saturday at 11. Since you mentioned going lighter for the wedding, she could add face-framing highlights in the same visit: it's $95 more and adds about an hour. Totally fine to just do the cut and decide on colour another time.
cases.note: One suggestion tied to what she said, with the cost and time stated plainly.

cases.situation: 小さなお米屋をやっています。常連の田中さんが3ヶ月前に10kg買っていったので、そろそろかなと思ってLINEしたい。今年の新米のコシヒカリも入りました。
cases.reply: 田中さん、こんにちは。前回10kgお求めいただいてから3ヶ月ほど経ったので、そろそろかなと思ってご連絡しました。今年の新米のコシヒカリが入っています。前回と同じお米でも新米でも、ご希望があればお届けします。まだ残っていたら、気にせずスルーしてくださいね。
cases.note: 割引より、本当の理由がある声かけのほうが効く。気軽に断れるひと言があるから、次の注文につながる。

cases.situation: 我是做小程序的外包，帮张姐的社区烘焙店做的点单小程序刚上线两周，线上单量涨了四成，她之前提过店里老客很多。我觉得下一步做会员积分对她很有用，开发大概6800元、两周能上线，但不想像在推销。
cases.reply: 张姐，看到这两周线上单量涨了四成，真替你高兴。你之前提过老客很多，下一步比较自然的是加一个会员积分，复购一般靠这个。这块开发大概6800元，两周能上线。现在不急，你觉得有需要我再出个方案，不做也完全没问题。
cases.note: 在对方体验好的时候提，只提一个，说清价格和工期，最后给一个轻松的不。

cases.situation: I'm a wedding photographer. A couple booked my 6-hour package ($2,800) for their wedding on Saturday 17 October, and I suggested adding a second shooter for $600 since they have 180 guests. The bride replied: 'We told you our budget is tight, can you please stop upselling us.'
cases.reply: Fair enough, that came across as a sell rather than a suggestion, and that wasn't the idea. You're all set with the 6-hour package for Saturday 17 October, and I'll make sure the ceremony and speeches are covered from the best angles. I'll send the draft shot list by Friday.
cases.note: After a no that stings, own it in one line and confirm the original booking; never raise the second shooter again unless they ask.

cases.situation: I'm an account manager at a small scheduling software company. A dental practice, Bright Smile Dental, has paid our monthly plan ($89) for 14 months and renews Oct 12. Annual is $890, paid up front and refundable only in the first 30 days. Their office manager Tanya has never asked about it.
cases.reply: Hi Tanya, a quick one before your renewal on October 12. You've been with us 14 months on the monthly plan, so it looks like the tool is here to stay. On the annual plan you'd pay $890 for the year instead of $1,068, which saves $178. The trade-off is paying it all up front, and it's only refundable in the first 30 days. If monthly suits your cash flow better, nothing changes and there's no need to reply.
cases.note: B2B renewal: the reason is their own 14-month history, the saving and the catch are both in numbers, and silence is a valid answer.

cases.situation: I run a cleaning service. Last week Nora booked a $110 standard clean for Thursday 1 October at 10am and said no when I mentioned the $40 oven add-on, which takes about 45 minutes. Now she's texted 'how much was the oven thing again? could you add it Thursday?'
cases.reply: Of course. The oven clean is $40 on top of your $110 standard clean and adds about 45 minutes. I'll put it on Thursday 1 October at 10am, $150 in total. Reply yes and it's booked.
cases.note: Answer as if it's the first time she's asked: no 'as I mentioned', and no extra pitch while she's saying yes.

cases.situation: Tenho uma oficina de bicicletas em Curitiba. O Fernando perguntou qual a diferença entre a revisão básica (R$ 120: freios, marchas, lubrificação e calibragem) e a completa (R$ 280, que inclui desmontar e engraxar os rolamentos do movimento central e das rodas). Ele usa a bike só para ir ao trabalho, 5 km por dia, ela tem um ano, e tenho horário no sábado, dia 3, de manhã.
cases.reply: Oi, Fernando! A completa custa R$ 160 a mais, e a diferença real é que desmontamos e engraxamos os rolamentos do movimento central e das rodas. Para uma bike de um ano rodando 5 km por dia, a básica resolve bem: freios, marchas, lubrificação e calibragem. A completa começa a valer a pena no segundo ou terceiro ano, ou se aparecer algum barulho. Quer que eu agende a básica para sábado, dia 3, de manhã?
cases.note: Quando perguntam a diferença: uma diferença concreta e a verdade sobre quando vale a pena. O downsell honesto é o que dá credibilidade à próxima recomendação.

cases.situation: 我是健身房私教，学员小陈买的20节课还剩2节。两个月里他深蹲从40公斤练到了70公斤，腰也不疼了。再买20节课包是5400元，每节比单买便宜30元，我想提一下续课，但不想像在推销。
cases.reply: 小陈，还剩两节课了。这两个月你深蹲从40公斤到了70公斤，腰也不疼了，进步真的很明显。如果接下来想继续练增肌，比较合适的是再买20节的课包，一共5400元，每节比单买便宜30元。说实话，现在动作你都掌握了，自己按计划练也完全可以，我可以把接下来两个月的计划写好发你。你考虑看看，不续也没关系。
cases.note: 在效果最好的时候提，只提一个选项，价格说清楚，同时给出不花钱的选择；诚实的替代方案才让建议可信。

cases.situation: I'm Dan, a heating engineer at Warmway Heating. Mr. Okafor's 11-year-old boiler had its $95 service last Oct 14 and he hasn't booked this year's. I have Thursday Oct 8 at 9am or Tuesday Oct 13 at 2pm free, and I want to text a reminder that doesn't read like a sales pitch.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Okafor, it's Dan from Warmway Heating. Your boiler's yearly service comes up around Oct 14, and it's worth doing before the first cold week, since that's when an 11-year-old boiler is most likely to play up. Same $95 as last year. I have Thursday Oct 8 at 9am or Tuesday Oct 13 at 2pm; if you'd rather leave it for now, no problem at all.
cases.note: A repeat-service nudge works on a real reason and real dates, not a discount, and the easy no stays in.

cases.situation: I own a small garage. Mrs. Patel brought her 2019 Corolla in for a $79 oil change. Her front brake pads are at 4mm, so they'll need doing in the next few months, not today. Fitted pads are $180. I want to mention it without scaring her into it.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs. Patel, your Corolla's ready: oil and filter changed, $79 as quoted. One thing we noticed: the front brake pads are at 4mm, which is fine for now, but they'll need replacing in the next few months depending on how much you drive. It's $180 fitted, and we can do it today or at your next visit, whichever suits you. I just didn't want it to come as a surprise.
cases.note: Honest timing is the whole point: say what's safe now and when it won't be, and never turn 'soon' into 'today'.

cases.situation: 我是大理半山民宿的老周。客人刘先生订了10月16日到18日两晚标准间，每晚380元，备注说是结婚十周年。那两晚海景房还空着，每晚580元，躺在床上就能看到洱海日出；标准间采光好也安静。想入住前在微信上提一下，不想像推销。
cases.reply: 刘先生您好，我是半山民宿的老周，您10月16日到18日两晚的标准间已经确认好了。看到备注说是结婚十周年，先恭喜二位！那两晚我们的海景房还空着，躺在床上就能看到洱海日出，每晚580元，比标准间多200元。标准间采光好也安静，住着完全舒服。想换的话回我一句就行，不换也没关系，到时候见。
cases.note: 入住前提一次、只提一个选项，理由来自客人自己的备注，差价说清楚，并诚实说明原房间也很好。

cases.situation: Ich gebe Mathe-Nachhilfe. Mein Schüler Jonas, 10. Klasse, kommt seit September einmal pro Woche für 60 Minuten zu 35 Euro; bei Gleichungen hat er gut aufgeholt, aber bei Funktionen, die in der Abschlussprüfung Ende Mai oft drankommen, hakt es noch. Ich möchte seiner Mutter, Frau Brandt, ab Januar eine zweite Stunde pro Woche vorschlagen, ohne dass es nach Geschäftemacherei klingt; mit meinen Übungsblättern zu Hause ginge es zur Not auch mit einer.
cases.reply: Liebe Frau Brandt, Jonas ist seit September gut dabei, bei den Gleichungen sieht man den Fortschritt deutlich. Bei den Funktionen braucht er noch mehr Übung, und die kommen in der Abschlussprüfung erfahrungsgemäß oft dran. Mein Vorschlag wäre deshalb, ab Januar bis zur Prüfung eine zweite Stunde pro Woche dazuzunehmen, also 70 statt 35 Euro wöchentlich. Ehrlich gesagt geht es auch mit einer Stunde, wenn er die Übungsblätter, die ich ihm mitgebe, zu Hause durcharbeitet. Sagen Sie einfach, was für Sie besser passt, beides ist völlig in Ordnung.
cases.note: Ein Vorschlag mit echtem Grund, klaren Kosten und einer kostenlosen Alternative, damit ein Nein sich nicht wie Sparen am Kind anfühlt.

cases.situation: 我开了家小印刷店。一家培训机构的行政小吴要印300份课程宣传册，每份3.2元，周五下午能取。她顺口提到这个课程每个季度都办一次，内容基本不变。一次印1200份的话每份只要1.9元。
cases.reply: 小吴你好，300份宣传册没问题，周五下午就能取。你提到这个课程每个季度都办，顺便说一下：一次印1200份的话每份1.9元，总共2280元，比每季度印300份一年下来省1560元左右。不过有两点要先想好：册子上如果有日期或价格，改了就用不了；另外要有地方放这么多册子。只印300份也完全没问题，你定就好。
cases.note: 批量建议只在对方自己说过会重复用时才提，省的钱和代价（内容过期、占地方）要一起说。

cases.situation: 我做公司团餐。行政小李订了10月12日周一的午餐，3份大拼盘，每份按10人份做，480元一份，但她备注说参会的有40个人。
cases.reply: 小李你好，10月12日周一中午的3份大拼盘已经记下了。看到你备注说有40个人，我们每份是按10个人的量做的，3份大概够30个人吃，要不要加一份？加的话多480元，总共1920元。如果有人不吃，或者另外备了点心，3份也够，你定就好。
cases.note: 建议来自她自己写的人数，差价和不需要加的情况都说清楚，这是帮她避免不够吃，不是多卖。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance web designer. I launched a website for Rosa's florist shop on Monday and she's thrilled. I offer a $60 a month maintenance plan (updates, backups, small edits), but she only changes her prices twice a year, and a free 30-minute handover session would teach her to do that herself.
cases.reply: Rosa, so glad you're happy with the site, it's live and all yours. Since you mentioned you only change prices a couple of times a year, the free 30-minute handover will probably cover you: I'll show you how to edit prices and photos yourself. If you'd rather not touch it at all, there's also my maintenance plan at $60 a month, which covers updates, backups and small edits. No need for it though, the handover alone is a perfectly good setup.
cases.note: Leading with the free option is what makes the paid one read as advice.

cases.situation: I run a mobile dog grooming van. Mrs. Chen booked a $55 bath for her cockapoo Bramble, and his coat is badly matted behind the ears. A full groom would fix it for $95 and take about another hour. She's waiting nearby and mentioned she has somewhere to be at 3pm.
cases.reply: Bramble's bath is all done and he was a star. He's quite matted behind the ears, so a full groom would sort that properly: it's $95 instead of $55 and takes about another hour. If that doesn't fit with your 3pm, the bath alone is completely fine for today and we can do the full groom next time.
cases.note: Naming the time cost alongside the price is what keeps it advice rather than a pitch.

cases.situation: I manage a small gym. Aaron is on our off-peak membership ($25 a month, entry before 4pm only) and has been turned away at the front desk twice this month for coming in at 6pm. Full membership is $39 a month, and switching takes effect from his next payment.
cases.reply: Hi Aaron, sorry you were turned away at the desk twice this month. The off-peak membership only covers entry before 4pm. Since you've been coming in the evenings, the full membership would let you in any time for $39 a month instead of $25, starting from your next payment. If evenings were just a one-off, off-peak is the better deal and nothing needs to change; just reply if you'd like to switch.
cases.note: When their own use has outgrown the plan, the upgrade answers a problem they've already hit; still name the extra cost and say when the cheaper plan stays the better deal.

cases.situation: Trabajo en una tienda de informática en Valencia. Una clienta, Rosa, compra un portátil de 699 € para su hija, que empieza la universidad, y me ha contado que el anterior se lo cargó derramando un café encima. Tenemos una ampliación de garantía a tres años que cubre daños accidentales por 129 €.
cases.reply: Perfecto, Rosa, el portátil de 699 € ya está listo. Como me contaba lo del café con el anterior, le comento una cosa: la ampliación de garantía a tres años cubre también derrames y golpes, por 129 €. Es casi una quinta parte del precio del portátil, así que si su hija lo cuida bien, sin ella va perfectamente. Si quiere, le doy las condiciones por escrito para que las mire con calma; con o sin ella, está bien.
cases.note: Una sola sugerencia ligada a lo que ella contó, el coste en claro y las condiciones para leer antes de decidir.

cases.situation: I sell handmade ceramic planters online. Aisha ordered a $48 planter shipped straight to her mum as a birthday present for Oct 8. I'm posting it tomorrow morning and standard shipping takes 3 to 4 days. Gift wrap with a handwritten card is $6, and I always leave the price slip out of gift orders for free.
cases.reply: Hi Aisha, your planter goes out tomorrow morning, so it should reach your mum a few days before the 8th. Since it's going straight to her, I can gift-wrap it and add a handwritten card with your message for $6. Either way I'll leave the price slip out. It's perfectly nice as it is, so no need if you'd rather keep it simple; just let me know by tonight if you'd like the wrap.
cases.note: The deadline is real (posting tomorrow), so it can be named without being pressure.

cases.situation: Ich leite ein kleines Yogastudio. Lena kommt seit Anfang September zu Einzelstunden für je 18 Euro, im September war sie sieben Mal da, und nach der Stunde heute meinte sie, sie will auf jeden Fall dabeibleiben. Unsere Zehnerkarte kostet 150 Euro und gilt sechs Monate.
cases.reply: Schön, dass es dir so gefällt, Lena! Weil du im September sieben Mal da warst: Mit der Zehnerkarte für 150 Euro zahlst du 15 statt 18 Euro pro Stunde. Sie gilt allerdings nur sechs Monate, lohnt sich also nur, wenn du ungefähr so oft weiterkommst. Mit Einzelstunden bist du genauso willkommen, sag einfach, was dir lieber ist.
cases.note: Der Vorschlag kommt direkt nach ihrer eigenen Aussage, die Rechnung ist offen, der Haken mit der Gültigkeit wird genannt, und ein Nein kostet nichts.

cases.situation: I make chilli crisp at home and sell it to friends. My friend Leah buys two 200g jars every month at $9 each and collects on Saturdays, and she's mentioned her flatmates eat it too so it goes fast. I've just started a 500g jar for $19.
cases.reply: Your two jars are ready for Saturday, Leah. Since you said your flatmates get through it too, the new 500g jar might suit you better: $19 for 500g, against $18 for your usual 400g. If the smaller jars are easier for you, keep them, either is great.
cases.note: Selling to a friend makes the easy no matter more, not less: one option, the sum done for her, and no follow-up if she passes.

cases.situation: 我开儿童摄影工作室，上周给王女士家宝宝拍了周岁照，电子版昨天发给她了，她说特别喜欢，还说爷爷奶奶不太会用手机看照片。我们有30页的实体相册，880元，制作要两周。
cases.reply: 王女士，很高兴您喜欢这组周岁照！您提到爷爷奶奶不太会用手机看照片，如果想让他们拿在手里翻，我们可以做一本30页的实体相册，880元，制作大概两周。电子版您打印几张放相框里也很好，不做相册完全没问题。需要的话回我一句，我把排版先发您看。
cases.note: 在对方满意之后提，理由来自她自己说的话，价格和工期说清，并给一个不花钱的替代。

cases.situation: I'm a receptionist at a vet clinic. Mr. Alvarez is on the phone booking his 9-year-old lab, Biscuit, for vaccinations on Tuesday Oct 6 at 4pm. At Biscuit's April visit the vet noted tartar and recommended a dental check within six months; adding it to Tuesday's visit is $35 and 15 extra minutes, against $60 as a separate appointment.
cases.reply: Lovely, Biscuit's booked for his vaccinations on Tuesday 6 October at 4pm. One thing from his notes: in April the vet suggested a dental check within six months because of some tartar. We can add it to Tuesday's visit for $35 and about 15 extra minutes, or it's $60 as a separate appointment later. Totally fine to keep it to the vaccinations, just let me know if you'd like it added.
cases.note: The reason comes from the vet's own note, not the receptionist's pitch; state the price and time, then let a no be a no.

cases.situation: I run a small invoicing software business. Kestrel Dental has paid for our Pro plan ($149 a month) for eight months, but only three people have ever logged in and they've never switched on the payroll module, which is the main Pro feature. Our Standard plan is $69 a month for up to five users, their renewal is on 20 October, and their office manager is Leon.
cases.reply: Hi Leon, a quick note before Kestrel Dental's renewal on 20 October. Looking at your account, three people use it and the payroll module hasn't been switched on in eight months, so you're paying for Pro features you don't use. Our Standard plan covers up to five users and everything you use today, at $69 a month instead of $149, which saves you $960 a year. The one thing you'd give up is payroll, so if you're planning to bring that in soon, staying on Pro makes sense. Just reply if you'd like me to switch you before the renewal; if not, nothing changes.
cases.note: An unprompted downsell to a paying customer is the trust that makes your next suggestion believable; don't pair it with a new pitch.

cases.situation: I run a small alterations shop. Daniel brought in his suit to have the trousers hemmed ($25, ready Friday 2 October) for a job interview on Monday 5 October. When he tried the jacket on, the sleeves covered his shirt cuffs completely; shortening them is $35 and would make the whole suit ready Saturday 3 October instead.
cases.reply: All pinned, Daniel: the trousers will be hemmed for $25 and ready Friday. One thing I noticed when you tried the jacket on: the sleeves cover your shirt cuffs completely, and taking them up a little is what usually makes a suit look made for you. That's $35 more, and the whole suit would be ready Saturday instead of Friday, still in good time for Monday. The trousers alone are absolutely fine if you'd rather keep it simple; just say before you go.
cases.note: The suggestion comes from what you both saw in the mirror, and the price and the extra day are named so a no is easy.

cases.situation: I teach piano. My adult student Greg has 30-minute lessons at $35 and is preparing a Chopin nocturne to play at his daughter's wedding on 12 December. I suggested 45-minute lessons at $50 so we'd have time to play the whole piece through each week, and he asked, half joking, 'Be honest, is that just you making more money?' If he keeps practising 20 minutes a day, 30 minutes would still get him there.
cases.reply: Fair question. Yes, it's $15 more a week, so I'd only suggest it if it helps you: with 45 minutes we can play the whole nocturne through every lesson, not just the tricky bars. Honestly, if you keep up your 20 minutes a day, 30-minute lessons will still get you ready for 12 December. Your call, and I'm happy either way.
cases.note: When they call out the sale, agree on the money first, then give the honest case for the cheaper option; never raise it again unless he does.

cases.situation: I run a small florist. Hannah ordered a $90 wreath for her grandfather's funeral on Saturday 10 October and mentioned her grandmother will be at home alone afterwards. We could deliver a small posy to her grandmother's house that afternoon for $35, and I don't want to sound like I'm selling to someone who's grieving.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, I'm so sorry about your grandfather. The wreath is all set for Saturday 10 October. Since you mentioned your grandmother will be at home afterwards, we could take a small posy to her that afternoon for $35, if you'd like something waiting for her. Please don't feel you need to; the wreath is complete on its own, and you only need to reply if you'd like the posy.
cases.note: With someone grieving, offer once, make silence the no, and never follow up on it.

cases.situation: I'm Kofi, a decorator. I've quoted Ms Reyes $420 to paint her spare bedroom on Wednesday 14 October, and while I was measuring she said the hallway walls, the same white as the bedroom, are scuffed from her kids' bikes. I could paint the hallway straight after on Thursday 15 October for $260, or $320 as a separate visit later, and if it's only the scuffs, a touch-up with the leftover white I'd leave her might be enough.
cases.reply: Hi Ms Reyes, the spare bedroom is booked for Wednesday 14 October at $420. Since you mentioned the bike scuffs in the hallway, I could paint it straight after on Thursday 15 October for $260, which is $60 less than a separate visit later because I'll already be set up. Honestly, if it's only the scuffs, I can leave you the leftover white and a touch-up might be all it needs. The bedroom on its own is completely fine; just let me know if you'd like the hallway added.
cases.note: The suggestion comes from her own comment, the saving is real rather than a deadline, and the free option sits right next to the paid one.

cases.situation: 我在一家小眼镜店上班。顾客王师傅来配近视眼镜，选了380元的普通树脂镜片，配镜时提到他晚上跑网约车，对面车灯晃得眼睛难受。我们有一款带防眩光膜层的镜片，贵260元，能减少镜片表面的反光，但对迎面车灯直射的帮助有限。
cases.reply: 王师傅，镜片就按您选的380元这款配，没问题。您说晚上开车车灯晃眼，我们有一款带防眩光膜层的，贵260元，能减少镜片本身的反光，但对迎面车灯直射的帮助有限，不是换了就完全不晃。您觉得值就换，不需要的话就按原来的配，都可以。
cases.note: 如果他说晃得越来越厉害，建议他先去医院眼科检查，而不是靠镜片解决。
